name: The Prison of Winter
description:
Ysolde finds a prison built to hold a curse, with every cell door facing inward.

Use Cataclysm's Cursed Eye to find the Frosted Prison and resolve the Maledictus encounter. Defeat the named boss once; tracked earlier kills may count.

Legacy commendation: a victory or advancement earned on another story path can satisfy this record. This does not create a separate instance of the encounter.
